note: Deck wording: In which part of the municipality is the most construction currently taking place? Construction is a pand with status Bouw gestart. Per CBS wijk, Vathorst-De Laak leads with 52 panden, ahead of Vathorst-De Velden with 47 and Vathorst-Bovenduist with 42. All wijken of Vathorst together (the names that start with Vathorst, and Bedrijventerrein Vathorst) have 159, so Vathorst as a whole leads too; both answers count. Counting verblijfsobjecten in those panden keeps Vathorst ahead as a whole, 646 against 460 for De Hoef, but per wijk De Hoef then leads, ahead of Vathorst-Bovenduist with 288. Counting verblijfsobjecten with status Verblijfsobject gevormd makes De Hoef lead with 1,272, but that status includes permits for which construction has not started. Whether De Hoef also counts as an answer, and whether a part is a wijk or a larger area, is open for the working group.
